# Components

> Personal library of copy-in React, TypeScript and Tailwind components, blocks and runnable app templates. Search catalog/index.json to find a component; each lives at components/<category>/<slug>/ with index.tsx, meta.json, README.md, demos/ and previews/. If meta.json has `install`, add it with `npx shadcn@latest add <install>`; otherwise copy the folder.

Generated by `pnpm run index`. Live gallery: https://aliakseych.github.io/components/

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/README.md): setup, commands and how to connect agents
- [Conventions](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/docs/conventions.md): folder layout, code and visual rules
- [Metadata schema](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/docs/metadata-schema.md): meta.json fields
- [Catalog index](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/catalog/index.json): machine-readable list of components, tags, blocks and templates

## Templates

- [Invest App](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/templates/invest-app/README.md): Mobile investing app: deal pools, deal and company pages, portfolio with payout schedules, top-up and invest drawers, onboarding chat and an AI assistant that answers with charts, deal cards and actions.
- [Telegram-style Messenger](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/templates/telegram-app/README.md): Mobile messenger modelled on Telegram's open-source client: chat list with folder tabs, pinned and muted chats, unread badges, chat screen with bubbles, replies, reactions, voice and photo messages, group chat, profile with shared media, and settings.

## Actions

Buttons and other controls that trigger something.

- [Button](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/actions/button/README.md): The standard shadcn button with variants and sizes, plus ByosUI patterns for copy feedback, async state, expanding and sliding icons.
- [Button Group](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/actions/button-group/README.md): Joins related buttons into one connected control: pagination, view switcher, zoom, split menu and vertical groups.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/actions/dropdown-menu/README.md): A button that opens a list of actions, with groups and shortcuts.
- [Magnetic Button](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/actions/magnetic-button/README.md): A button that gently follows a mouse cursor while hovered.

## AI Chat

Composers, thinking states, tool activity and context for AI assistants.

- [AI Assistant: Side Panel](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/ai-assistant-01/README.md): An assistant docked beside the page, with suggested prompts, the page as context, and New conversation and Close buttons.
- [AI Assistant: Conversation](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/ai-assistant-02/README.md): A conversation with a table and a SQL query, where you can attach a file, copy, rate or regenerate a reply, or pick a follow-up question.
- [AI Assistant: Ask About Data](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/ai-assistant-03/README.md): Questions about this month's [AI Usage](/docs/blocks/ai-usage) numbers, with the tokens and cost of each answer and a change that waits for your approval.
- [AI Assistant: Retry](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/ai-assistant-04/README.md): A reply that failed, kept in the conversation with a button to try again.
- [Call Chip](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/call-chip/README.md): A compact row showing one agent tool call, such as a search, with its icon, argument, progress and result.
- [Chain of Thought](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/chain-of-thought/README.md): A collapsible list of an AI's reasoning steps, with search results and images.
- [Chat Composer](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/chat-composer/README.md): An AI chat input card with a growing textarea, attach button, slot for tools such as a model picker, and a round send button that becomes stop while the assistant replies.
- [Chat Screen](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/chat-screen/README.md): A full AI chat layout: header, scrolling conversation with auto-scroll, an empty state with starter questions, and the composer pinned at the bottom.
- [Context Usage](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/context/README.md): A small ring showing how much of an AI model's context is used, with a hover card of token details.
- [Conversation](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/conversation/README.md): The turns of an AI chat: right-aligned user bubbles, open assistant replies with a mark, copy, feedback and regenerate actions, failed replies with retry and a typing indicator.
- [Lattice Loader](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/lattice-loader/README.md): A small animated dot grid that shows waiting, then morphs into a tick or a cross, with an optional label and timer.
- [Live Orb](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/live-orb/README.md): A sphere with two capsule eyes that follow the pointer, showing an assistant's idle, listening or thinking state with breathing, a pulse ring or blinking.
- [Prompt Bar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/prompt-bar/README.md): An AI chat input. The classic bar has a level selector, sparks at the top level, a morphing send button, rotating placeholders, and optional sources, commands, models and dictation. The expanding pill rests as a mic pill and opens into a card with suggestions, a model picker and an effort chip.
- [Task](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/task/README.md): A collapsible task with its sub-steps and the files it touched.
- [Trace](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/ai-chat/trace/README.md): Compact lines of an agent's activity, with status and collapsible detail.

## App Interface

Navigation, menus, sidebars and overlays that frame an app.

- [App Shell: Sidebar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/app-shell-01/README.md): A workspace switcher, navigation sections with count badges and a user menu, under a top bar with breadcrumbs, search and notifications.
- [App Shell: Icon Sidebar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/app-shell-02/README.md): A sidebar that collapses to icons with tooltips, with nested sections and help and settings pinned to the bottom.
- [App Shell: Inset](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/app-shell-03/README.md): The page in a card beside the sidebar, with plan usage and an upgrade link above the user menu.
- [App Shell: Top Navigation](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/app-shell-04/README.md): Page links under the top bar instead of a sidebar, with the ones that don't fit under More on a small screen.
- [Cloudlet Toaster](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/cloudlet-toaster/README.md): Dynamic-island style notification stack with swipe, expand and progress, powered by @cloudlet/toast.
- [Command Menu: Pages and Actions](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/command-menu-01/README.md): Pages and actions with their shortcuts, opened here with <kbd>⌘/</kbd> because <kbd>⌘K</kbd> opens this site's search.
- [Command Menu: Record Search](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/command-menu-02/README.md): Recently viewed records before you type, then customers and orders fetched as you type.
- [Drawer](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/drawer/README.md): A panel that slides in from a screen edge and can be dragged closed.
- [Floating Menu](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/floating-menu/README.md): A pill at the bottom centre of a screen that widens into a panel of links when opened, with staggered item reveals and Escape to close.
- [Glimpse](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/glimpse/README.md): A hover card that previews a linked page, with a server helper that reads its title, description and image.
- [Menubar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/menubar/README.md): A desktop-style row of menus, such as File and Edit.
- [Navigation Menu](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/navigation-menu/README.md): A website header menu with panels of links.
- [Sidebar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/sidebar-glass/README.md): The ihsp-web floating glass sidebar with a logo toggle, nested nav data, role filtering, saved state and a user panel with a profile menu.
- [Tree](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/app-interface/tree/README.md): An animated, expandable tree with lines, icons and single or multiple selection.

## Code

Displaying, copying and running source code.

- [Code Block](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/code-block/README.md): Code display with syntax highlighting, line numbers, tabs for several files, and a copy button.
- [Notebook Cell](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/notebook-cell/README.md): A Jupyter-style cell with optional highlighted code (python, JavaScript, TypeScript or SQL), a Run button, an execution count, and an output that is text, a table or any node, with status and timing.
- [Package Info](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/package-info/README.md): A card showing a package's version change, description and dependencies.
- [Sandbox](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/sandbox/README.md): A live browser code playground with an editor, file tree, console and preview, powered by Sandpack.
- [Schema Display](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/schema-display/README.md): An API endpoint's method, path, parameters, and request and response fields.
- [Code Block (light)](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/shadcn-code-block/README.md): A lightweight code block with a title, copy button, optional line numbers and wrapping.
- [Snippet](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/code/snippet/README.md): A compact command block with tabs, such as for package managers, and a copy button.

## Collaboration

Showing several people working together.

- [Avatar Stack](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/collaboration/avatar-stack/README.md): Overlapping avatars that can spread apart on hover.
- [Collaborative Canvas](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/collaboration/collaborative-canvas/README.md): A dotted canvas with collaborator avatars and labeled cursors, including an optional simulated motion mode.
- [Cursor](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/collaboration/cursor/README.md): A labeled pointer with a name and message, for showing other people in a shared space.

## Data Display

Tables, charts, labels and other read-focused data.

- [Data Table: Sortable](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/data-table-01/README.md): A table you sort by any column, with a second click reversing the order.
- [Data Table: Inline Bars](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/data-table-02/README.md): Revenue by product, with a bar scaled to the top product and each product's share of the total.
- [Data Table: Trends](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/data-table-03/README.md): Campaign conversions and cost per conversion with their change, plus a 14-day sparkline.
- [Data Table: Status](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/data-table-04/README.md): Services with their status, latency and error rate, worst status first.
- [Data Table: Pagination](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/data-table-05/README.md): Recent orders, five to a page.
- [Data Table: Full Featured](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/data-table-06/README.md): Search, filters with counts, a column menu, page sizes, multi-column sorting and selected rows to export or email.
- [Org Tree (ReUI)](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/org-tree/README.md): Organisation chart as an expandable tree with avatar, name and role per person, built on headless-tree.
- [Pill](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/pill/README.md): Rounded labels with optional avatars, status dots, change indicators, icons and buttons.
- [Data Grid](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/data-display/table/README.md): A composable, sortable table built on TanStack Table with column header menus.

## Forms

Collecting and editing user input.

- [Cascader (ByosUI)](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/cascader/README.md): Nested option picker with drill-down, columns or tree modes, deep search, multi-select, async children and a virtualised list.
- [Combobox](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/combobox/README.md): A searchable dropdown for choosing from a list, with an option to create new values.
- [Rich Text Editor](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/editor/README.md): A Tiptap editor with a slash menu, formatting bubble menu, tables, code blocks, task lists and a character count.
- [Forms: Sections](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-01/README.md): Fields grouped into titled sections, with a save bar that counts unsaved changes.
- [Forms: Sheet](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-02/README.md): A record created in a panel that slides in from the side.
- [Forms: Wizard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-03/README.md): A form in steps, each checked before moving on, with a review of everything before it's created.
- [Forms: Inline Edit](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-04/README.md): One value edited at a time, in place.
- [Forms: Multi-select](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-05/README.md): Several values picked from a searchable list, each shown as a chip you can remove.
- [Forms: Choice Cards](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-06/README.md): One or several options drawn as cards, each with its price and a line of detail.
- [Forms: Number and Money](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-07/README.md): Numbers with their unit or currency, formatted when you leave the field, and minus and plus for a count.
- [Forms: Address](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/forms/forms-08/README.md): An address whose fields follow the country: a state and ZIP code in the US, a postcode in the UK, the postal code before the city in Germany.

## Hero Page

Backgrounds, marks and headline effects for the top of a page.

- [Chapter Rail](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/chapter-rail/README.md): Right-edge scroll rail: one dot per section, the current dot morphs into a pill that fills as the section scrolls by.
- [Decrypted Text](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/decrypted-text/README.md): Text that scrambles through random characters and resolves into the real words, on view, hover or click.
- [Gradient ASCII Background](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/gradient-ascii/README.md): An animated WebGL background with a horizon glow and random noise characters, usable together or as separate layers.
- [Halftone Mark](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/halftone-mark/README.md): An animated logo or icon filled with flowing colored light, shaped by any image you provide.
- [Prism Hero](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/prism-hero/README.md): A full-screen hero with a floating pill navbar, a large headline that reveals word by word, and a bottom-right call to action over a token-based atmosphere.
- [Scroll Morph Hero](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/scroll-morph-hero/README.md): A tall hero where tiles start scattered, gather into a circle and then spread into an arc as the page scrolls, with the headline fading out.
- [Scroll Story](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/hero-page/scroll-story/README.md): Pinned scroll story: captions blur-swap on the left while a scrubbed element on the right (a toast living through every state) animates with the scroll.

## Marketing

Sections that explain and sell a product.

- [Bento Grid](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/bento-grid/README.md): A responsive grid of rounded feature cards with numbered eyebrows, spans for wide, tall and full-width cards, a tinted accent area and a hover lift.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/changelog/README.md): A page section of dated, versioned updates with lists, images and links.
- [Display Cards: Stack](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/display-cards/README.md): Three offset cards stacked in depth, with the front card bottom-right. Hover or focus lifts a card forward and the back cards fade into grey.
- [Dithered Footer](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/dithered-footer/README.md): A light footer with a newsletter form and link columns, closed by a band where the brand is set over a drifting dot field that a pointer spotlight reveals.
- [Feature Showcase](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/feature/README.md): A marketing section where opening an accordion item changes the image beside it.
- [Halftone Footer](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/halftone-footer/README.md): A footer whose large wordmark is drawn as halftone dots on a canvas; the pointer pushes the dots away on springs and a click sends a ring through them.
- [Hills Footer](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/hills-footer/README.md): A footer whose headline and call to action sit over a canvas landscape of rolling hills that rise, drift with mist and follow the pointer, with link columns, a newsletter field and social links below.
- [Logo Cloud: Checkerboard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/logo-cloud/README.md): A bordered grid of customer or partner logos laid out as a checkerboard of tinted and transparent cells, with responsive columns and a hover and focus lift on each logo.
- [Pill Navbar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/pill-navbar/README.md): A floating content-width pill top bar with a stroke-drawn logo and logo hover menu, hover-wash nav items, multi-column mega dropdowns, icon quick-action tools with tooltips, and an 'on this page' mode that folds the nav into a section chip with progress and a section menu on scroll; collapses into a Menu/Close panel on narrow screens.
- [Pricing Tiers](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/pricing/README.md): Only the pricing plan cards, with animated prices and a highlighted plan.
- [Product Navbar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/product-navbar/README.md): A marketing top bar with dropdown menus of icon links, plain links and right-hand actions, collapsing into one disclosure panel on phones.
- [Product Rail Gallery](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/product-rail/README.md): A shop section with a chrome clothing rail: garments hang from hooks, turn from profile to front on selection, tilt toward the pointer, and open into a detail overlay with front and back faces.
- [Stats Band](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/stats-band/README.md): An eyebrow, heading and a row of headline figures with their change, built from the Stat Group: Plain Row, over an optional dot grid.
- [Stats: Showcase](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/stats-showcase/README.md): A heading over a two-by-two grid of stat cards, each with an icon chip, a large tabular number, a label, and a bar whose width is the number as a share of its maximum.
- [Testimonial Image Wheel](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/testimonial-globe/README.md): A testimonial block with a heading, review count, average rating and country count, and a slowly turning ring of avatars. The active review flies out of the ring beside its quote.
- [Waitlist: Split](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/marketing/waitlist-split/README.md): A split landing section with an announcement badge, headline, email request form, overlapping member avatars with a count, and a gradient panel holding a mock form card.

## Media

Working with images and swipeable cards.

- [Deck](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/media/deck/README.md): A stack of cards that people swipe left or right, flip to see the back, and shuffle.
- [Device Mockup](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/media/device-mockup/README.md): Laptop, phone, foldable and tablet mockup that springs between devices, with a 3D fold animation and a sliding device switcher.
- [Image Crop](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/media/image-crop/README.md): An image cropper with a draggable selection, reset and apply, which returns the cropped image as a data URL.

## Messaging

Conversations between people, such as messages and bubbles.

- [Bubble](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/bubble/README.md): A chat bubble from shadcn/ui with color variants, grouping, link or button content and reactions on either edge.
- [Comments: Discussion](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/comments-01/README.md): Threads with replies, reactions and a resolved thread, and a box to start a new one.
- [Comments: Update](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/comments-02/README.md): A composer with a preview of how mentions will look and who will be notified, above the latest updates.
- [Comments: Review](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/comments-03/README.md): Comments on a document in a column beside it, each quoting the words it's about.
- [Comments: Ticket](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/comments-04/README.md): A support ticket's conversation, with replies emailed to the customer and internal notes only the team sees.
- [Marker](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/marker/README.md): A quiet inline label or divider inside a conversation, such as a date or an event.
- [Message](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/messaging/message/README.md): A conversation row with an avatar, header, content and footer, aligned to either side.

## Planning

Calendars, timelines and task boards.

- [Calendar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/calendar/README.md): A month calendar where clicking a day opens a day strip and an hour-by-hour timeline, and dragging across days adds a multi-day event.
- [Calendar: Month](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/calendar-01/README.md): A month of team events, launches, travel and holidays, with the selected day's events listed beside the grid.
- [Calendar: Week](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/calendar-02/README.md): A week on an hour axis that opens at working hours, with all-day events at the top and the selected event's details.
- [Calendar: Planner](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/calendar-03/README.md): A content calendar that switches between month and week, with each calendar shown or hidden from the sidebar.
- [Calendar: Rooms](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/calendar-04/README.md): A day of meeting room bookings, with a column per room and whether it's free right now.
- [Checklist: Onboarding](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/checklist-01/README.md): Setup steps with a progress bar, the next step named, and each step opening to show what it involves.
- [Checklist: Stepper](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/checklist-02/README.md): The stages of a multi-stage setup, side by side when there's room and stacked when narrow.
- [Checklist: Progress Card](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/checklist-03/README.md): A compact block with the share of steps done and the next one, to bring people back to setup.
- [Checklist: Task List](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/checklist-04/README.md): Tasks grouped by team, with owners, due dates and checkboxes, and overdue tasks in red.
- [Event Calendar (ByosUI)](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/event-calendar/README.md): Full scheduling calendar with month, week, day, agenda and resource views, drag to move, resize and create, recurrence, time zones and i18n.
- [Gantt](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/gantt/README.md): A draggable project timeline with a sidebar, zoom, markers and daily, monthly or quarterly ranges.
- [Gantt Scheduler (ByosUI)](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/gantt-scheduler/README.md): Resource and task Gantt with drag, resize, dependencies, baselines, rollups, row reordering, recurrence and i18n.
- [Issue Split View](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/issue-split-view/README.md): Issues grouped by state with counts on the left, and the selected issue's description and properties on the right, collapsing to list-then-detail on phones.
- [Kanban](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/kanban/README.md): A drag-and-drop board of columns and cards on the dashboardblocks kanban, with buttons to add cards and columns.
- [Kanban: Sprint Board](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/kanban-01/README.md): Issues with labels, assignees, due dates, priorities, comments and subtasks, and columns that warn when past their WIP limit.
- [Kanban: Deals](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/kanban-02/README.md): A sales board with each column's total value and the next step on every deal.
- [Kanban: Support Queue](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/kanban-03/README.md): Tickets with priority and time left to their SLA, with a full column that refuses more tickets.
- [Kanban DnD (ByosUI)](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/kanban-dnd/README.md): Headless drag-and-drop kanban built on dnd-kit with column and card handles, placeholder or dynamic overlays and keyboard support.
- [Grouped List](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/list/README.md): A list of items in groups, where items can be dragged between groups.
- [Mini Calendar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/mini-calendar/README.md): A compact, scrollable row of days for selecting a date.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/roadmap/README.md): One set of features shown as switchable Gantt, calendar, list, kanban and table views.
- [Schedule: Agenda](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/schedule-01/README.md): Upcoming events grouped by day, with the event in progress marked.
- [Schedule: Calendar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/schedule-02/README.md): A month calendar with a dot for each event, listing the selected day's events.
- [Schedule: Deadlines](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/schedule-03/README.md): Deadlines and renewals in date order, each with a countdown coloured by how close it is.
- [Schedule: Week Ahead](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/schedule-04/README.md): The next seven days on a shared time axis, with how much of each day is booked and the busiest day.
- [Timeline: Roadmap](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/timeline-01/README.md): Projects grouped by team, each a bar from start to end filled to its progress, with a today line.
- [Timeline: Milestones](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/timeline-02/README.md): A launch plan on a rail, led by the days until the next milestone, with how soon or how late each one is.
- [Timeline: Release Cadence](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/timeline-03/README.md): Every release on one line, sized by major, minor and patch, with the median gap and when the next one is due.
- [Timeline: Plan vs Actual](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/planning/timeline-04/README.md): Each phase's plan as a dashed outline over what actually happened, with how many days it slipped.

## Analytics

KPIs, charts, funnels, maps and other ways to show measured data.

- [AI Usage: Token Usage](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/ai-usage-01/README.md): Tokens per day stacked by model against the daily average, with the total cost and the cost per million tokens.
- [AI Usage: Cost by Feature](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/ai-usage-02/README.md): Model spend by product feature, with each feature's input, cached and output tokens and its cost per thousand requests.
- [AI Usage: Model Performance](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/ai-usage-03/README.md): Requests, time to first token from the median to the 95th percentile, output speed and error rate for each model.
- [AI Usage: Prompt Caching](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/ai-usage-04/README.md): The share of input tokens served from the cache, its change, what it saved and what tokens would have cost without it.
- [KPI: Area Chart](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/area-chart-kpi-01/README.md): Gross profit with its margin, profit drawn inside revenue by day, and the day with the best margin.
- [KPI: Background Chart](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/area-chart-kpi-02/README.md): A large total with an area chart along the bottom, for the hero number at the top of a dashboard.
- [KPI: Bar Chart](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/bar-chart-kpi-01/README.md): The week's total with a bar for each day and the change on the week before.
- [KPI: Actual vs Goal](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/bar-chart-kpi-02/README.md): Each day's value with its goal marked on the bar, and the days that met it solid.
- [Breakdown: Segmented Bar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/breakdown-01/README.md): A single 100% bar with each category's value and share listed below.
- [Breakdown: Composition by Group](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/breakdown-02/README.md): The mix across groups, sorted by one category's share, which is labelled on every row.
- [Breakdown: Waffle](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/breakdown-03/README.md): A 10×10 grid where each square is 1% of the total.
- [Breakdown: Share Shift](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/breakdown-04/README.md): How each category's share moved between two periods, as two dots joined by a line.
- [Chart Panel: Period Comparison](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/chart-panel-01/README.md): This period as an area against the previous one as a dashed line, with the change written as a sentence.
- [Chart Panel: Metric Tabs](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/chart-panel-02/README.md): Related metrics as tabs, each with its total and change, and the chosen metric's average marked on the chart.
- [Chart Panel: Stacked Bars](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/chart-panel-03/README.md): Monthly totals split by category, with the average marked and the latest total labelled.
- [Chart Panel: Highlighted Bar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/chart-panel-04/README.md): A single series with the latest period highlighted against a goal line, and how far off the goal it is.
- [Chart Panel: Breakdown Donut](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/chart-panel-05/README.md): Part-to-whole at a glance, with values and shares listed beside the donut.
- [Chart Panel: Percentiles](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/chart-panel-06/README.md): Percentile lines in one hue from light to full strength, against an SLO line and how many hours went over it.
- [Comparison: Period over Period](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/comparison-01/README.md): Each metric this period and last, with the difference and the change, under a sentence saying how many improved.
- [Comparison: A/B Test](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/comparison-02/README.md): Lift for a variant over the control, with a 95% confidence interval drawn against zero and a sentence on what it means.
- [Comparison: What Changed](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/comparison-03/README.md): The net change, then the change in each segment as bars either side of zero, from the biggest gain to the biggest drop.
- [Comparison: Before and After](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/comparison-04/README.md): Two values per row on a shared scale, with a hollow dot for before and a filled dot for after.
- [Contribution Graph](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/contribution-graph/README.md): A year-long activity heatmap with month labels, a total count and a legend.
- [Distribution: Histogram](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/distribution-01/README.md): Response times in buckets with p50, p95 and p99 lines, and the share over the SLO in red.
- [Distribution: Box Plots](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/distribution-02/README.md): One box and whiskers per group on a shared axis, from the 5th to the 95th percentile.
- [Distribution: Spread](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/distribution-03/README.md): The median, mean and percentiles of raw values, with a note when a long tail pulls the mean away from the median.
- [Distribution: Before and After](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/distribution-04/README.md): This week's distribution against last week's, with both medians and the change at the median and p90.
- [Feedback: Ratings](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/feedback-01/README.md): The average rating with stars, the number of ratings and the share of each star, with CSAT and the change on the last period.
- [Feedback: Sentiment by Topic](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/feedback-02/README.md): Negative and positive mentions either side of a centre line for each topic, sorted by net sentiment.
- [Feedback: Recent Reviews](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/feedback-03/README.md): The latest reviews with their rating and source, and whether low ratings still need a reply.
- [Feedback: Customer Satisfaction](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/feedback-04/README.md): Weekly CSAT against a target line, with the change on the week before and how many weeks met the target.
- [Flow: Traffic Flow](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/flow-01/README.md): Sessions from each source, through the landing page, to signing up, browsing on or bouncing, with the page that converts best named.
- [Flow: User Paths](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/flow-02/README.md): Where visitors go in their first pages after landing, with the ones who left at each step.
- [Flow: Income Flow](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/flow-03/README.md): Revenue streams into revenue, then out to costs and profit, with each part's share of revenue.
- [Flow: Top Paths](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/flow-04/README.md): The most common routes as steps, ranked by how many took them, with how often each reaches the goal.
- [Forecast: Actual and Forecast](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/forecast-01/README.md): Weekly actuals continuing into a dashed forecast with a shaded 80% range and a today marker.
- [Forecast: Date to Target](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/forecast-02/README.md): The running total heading for a goal line, with the date the forecast reaches it and what each week needs to make the deadline.
- [Forecast: Run-Rate](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/forecast-03/README.md): Month to date, projected to the end of the month at the daily run-rate, with what's needed per day to hit the target.
- [Forecast: Scenarios](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/forecast-04/README.md): Low, base and high growth scenarios from the last actual, as a chart and a table with when each one reaches the target.
- [Funnel: Stage Bars](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/funnel-01/README.md): Overall conversion, then each stage as a bar sized against the first, with its step conversion.
- [Funnel: Columns](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/funnel-02/README.md): Each stage as a column on a 0 to 100% axis, topped by the share that left at that step, with the biggest drop named.
- [Funnel: Steps](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/funnel-03/README.md): A vertical stepper that names the step with the biggest drop-off.
- [Funnel: Segment Comparison](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/funnel-04/README.md): Two segments as lines through every stage, each as a share of its first step, with the gap between them shaded.
- [Gauge: Net Promoter Score](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/gauge-01/README.md): NPS on its full −100 to 100 scale, with the change since last period and the split of promoters, passives and detractors.
- [Gauge: Health Score](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/gauge-02/README.md): An account health score marked on poor, fair and good bands, with the factors that pull it down most.
- [Gauge: System Load](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/gauge-03/README.md): CPU, memory and disk as small gauges, each with its warning and critical thresholds.
- [Gauge: Score Card](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/gauge-04/README.md): A satisfaction score with a target tick on the arc, the change since last period and the points left to the target.
- [Geo: State Tile Map](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/geo-01/README.md): Revenue by state on a single-hue scale, with the total and the top five states as ranked bars.
- [Geo: Top Countries](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/geo-02/README.md): The leading countries with flags, values and shares, and the rest summed into one row.
- [Geo: Dotted World Map](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/geo-03/README.md): Active users by city right now, with markers sized by value and the busiest city named on the map.
- [Geo: Region Split](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/geo-04/README.md): Revenue split across regions, each with its share and change on the previous quarter.
- [Goals: Target](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/goals-01/README.md): One target with where today's pace ends up and how much a day is left to do.
- [Goals: Goal List](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/goals-02/README.md): Several goals for the same period, each with its own pace.
- [Goals: Projection](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/goals-03/README.md): Cumulative progress this month, projected to the end of the month, with the day it reaches the target or how far short it ends.
- [Goals: Daily Rings](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/goals-04/README.md): Small daily goals as rings, each saying how many are left or how far past the goal it went.
- [Heatmap: Weekday by Hour](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/heatmap-01/README.md): When visitors arrive, by day of the week and hour of the day, with each hour's total in bars above the grid.
- [Heatmap: Cohort Retention](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/heatmap-02/README.md): The share of each weekly signup cohort still active in each week after signup.
- [Heatmap: Calendar](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/heatmap-03/README.md): A year of daily values, with the busiest day and the longest run of active days.
- [Heatmap: Hot Spots](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/heatmap-04/README.md): p95 latency by endpoint over the last 24 hours, with a dot on each window over the target.
- [Insights: Feed](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/insights-01/README.md): A list of insights, each with its kind, topic, sentence, an optional line of drivers and a link to explore.
- [Insights: Anomaly Callout](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/insights-02/README.md): An unusual reading against the range it was expected to fall in, with the worst day labelled, the explanation and the likely causes.
- [Insights: Key Drivers](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/insights-03/README.md): What contributed to a change, as bars either side of zero, under a sentence naming the biggest driver and drag.
- [Insights: Weekly Digest](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/insights-04/README.md): A headline, three takeaways and buttons to say whether it helped.
- [KPI: Headline](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/kpi-01/README.md): A value with its change and what it's compared with.
- [KPI: Compact](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/kpi-02/README.md): A value with its change written beside the label, for a tight grid of KPIs.
- [KPI: Previous Value](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/kpi-03/README.md): A rate beside its previous value, with the change in percentage points.
- [KPI: Provenance](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/kpi-04/README.md): A value with a button that says how it was computed: what's counted, the dates, the filters, the query and a link to the rows.
- [KPI: Row](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/kpi-05/README.md): A row of headline KPIs, each in its own card, for the top of a dashboard.
- [Leaderboard: Share Bars](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/leaderboard-01/README.md): Ranked rows with a bar sized relative to the leader, and how much of the traffic the top page drew.
- [Leaderboard: Team Ranking](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/leaderboard-02/README.md): People ranked by revenue, each bar running to the person's quota, with the change on the last period.
- [Leaderboard: Podium](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/leaderboard-03/README.md): The top three on a podium sized by their totals, with the rest of the field listed below.
- [Leaderboard: Rank Movement](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/leaderboard-04/README.md): Products ranked by revenue, with how many places each moved and the biggest climber named.
- [Leaderboard: Sortable](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/leaderboard-05/README.md): A ranking you can reverse and expand to show every entry.
- [KPI: Line Chart](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/line-chart-kpi-01/README.md): This week as a filled area over last week as a dashed line, with the days it fell behind written underneath.
- [Metric List: Sparklines](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/metric-list-01/README.md): Metrics with their change and a 14-day sparkline.
- [Metric List: Sections](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/metric-list-02/README.md): Metrics grouped into sections, each with a header and how many of its metrics improved.
- [Metric List: Targets](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/metric-list-03/README.md): Metrics against their targets, floors or ceilings, each with a bar, a tick at the target and a status.
- [Metric List: Watchlist](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/metric-list-04/README.md): A list of metrics beside a chart of the selected one against its 30-day average.
- [KPI: Target Pace](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/progress-kpi-01/README.md): Progress to a monthly target, with where the current pace ends the month and where an even pace would be today.
- [KPI: Status Breakdown](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/progress-kpi-02/README.md): The share of work done, as one bar split by status, with a count for each.
- [KPI: Goal Ring](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/progress-kpi-03/README.md): A count against a goal as a ring, with how many are left and how many a day that takes.
- [Realtime: Right Now](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/realtime-01/README.md): Active users, page views per second over the last minute and the pages with the most people on them.
- [Realtime: Throughput](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/realtime-02/README.md): Requests per second over the last five minutes, with the peak, the error rate and errors on their own scale.
- [Realtime: Live Activity](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/realtime-03/README.md): Orders, sign-ups, refunds and messages as they arrive, newest first, with a pause button.
- [Realtime: Today So Far](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/realtime-04/README.md): Running totals since midnight against yesterday at the same time, with orders per hour beside yesterday's.
- [Retention: Cohort Table](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/retention-01/README.md): A retention triangle with one row per cohort and an average row weighted by cohort size.
- [Retention: Retention Curves](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/retention-02/README.md): Every cohort's curve, with one highlighted against the average, and a line where the average levels off.
- [Retention: Milestones](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/retention-03/README.md): Day 1, 7 and 30 retention for the latest cohort, with the change against the cohort before.
- [Retention: Growth Accounting](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/retention-04/README.md): Users gained above the axis and lost below it, with the net change and the quick ratio of users gained for each one lost.
- [Scatter: Correlation](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/scatter-01/README.md): Pages by load time and conversion rate, grouped by section, with a trend line and how strong the relationship is.
- [Scatter: Quadrants](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/scatter-02/README.md): Features by usage and satisfaction, split at the medians into four labelled quadrants.
- [Scatter: Bubbles](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/scatter-03/README.md): Campaigns by cost per acquisition and conversion rate, sized by spend and coloured by channel, against a target cost.
- [Scatter: Risk Matrix](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/scatter-04/README.md): Open risks on a likelihood by impact grid, with a cell's risks listed when you select it.
- [Stat Group: Plain Row](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/stat-group-01/README.md): Metrics side by side, each with its change written as a sentence.
- [Stat Group: With Sparklines](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/stat-group-02/README.md): Each metric with a 14-day sparkline, under a sentence saying how many improved.
- [Stat Group: Metric Tabs](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/stat-group-03/README.md): Metrics as tabs, with the selected one charted by day over the previous period.
- [Stat Group: Compact Strip](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/stat-group-04/README.md): Five metrics in a slim row.
- [Stat Group: Period Bars](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/analytics/stat-group-05/README.md): Four metrics, each with a bar for this period over a bar for the one before.

## Dashboard

The frame of a dashboard: shells, headers, states and complete pages.

- [Dashboard: Store dashboard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-01/README.md): A store dashboard: header filters scope stats, revenue, channels, products, a checkout funnel and month-to-date revenue, with low stock alongside.
- [Dashboard: SaaS dashboard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-02/README.md): A SaaS dashboard: metric tabs, an activity heatmap, MRR by region, MRR movement, retention milestones and service status, filtered by plan.
- [Dashboard: Web analytics dashboard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-03/README.md): A web analytics dashboard: traffic tabs, visitors right now, a traffic flow, top pages, top countries and browsers, filtered by device.
- [Dashboard: CRM dashboard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-04/README.md): A CRM dashboard: sales stats, open pipeline by stage, monthly bookings, lead conversion, a quarter forecast by rep, deal activity and stuck deals, filtered by segment.
- [Dashboard: DevOps dashboard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-05/README.md): A DevOps dashboard: live throughput, delivery performance, response time percentiles, open alerts, uptime, build health and recent deployments, filtered by service.
- [Dashboard Header: Full Header](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-header-01/README.md): The range and the comparison read as a sentence under the title, with each filter as a removable tag.
- [Dashboard Header: Compact](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-header-02/README.md): The date range as part of the title, with the exact dates under it and export beside it.
- [Dashboard Header: Segmented Presets](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-header-03/README.md): Date range presets as a segmented control, with a compare switch and a filter tag.
- [Dashboard Header: Last Updated](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/dashboard-header-04/README.md): A description, the time of the last update and a refresh button, beside the date range and export.
- [Gooey Loader](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/gooey-loader/README.md): Three circles that swing side to side, merge and separate, joined by an SVG gooey filter, in any colour.
- [Page Header: Actions](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/page-header-01/README.md): A title and description with a secondary and a main action.
- [Page Header: Tabs](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/page-header-02/README.md): The status as a badge beside the title, and links to the page's sections with their counts.
- [Page Header: Record](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/page-header-03/README.md): A back link, a photo, the customer's key numbers in a row and a menu for less common actions.
- [Page Header: List](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/page-header-04/README.md): The count beside the title, with search and the main action on the same row.
- [States: Skeleton](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/states-01/README.md): Placeholders sized to match the loaded stats, so nothing shifts when the data arrives.
- [States: Refresh](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/states-02/README.md): A chart that stays in place, dimmed, while it refreshes.
- [States: Empty](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/states-03/README.md): A filtered table with no matching rows that says why it's empty and offers a way out.
- [States: Error](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/states-04/README.md): A block whose request fails, saying it couldn't load in place of the number while the chart keeps its space.
- [Wave Spinner](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/dashboard/wave-spinner/README.md): A grid of square cells that pulse in a diagonal, centre or plus wave, fading between two theme colours as it passes.

## Business

Billing, spend, usage, inventory, pipelines and invoices.

- [Billing: MRR Movement](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/billing-01/README.md): Ending MRR against the start of the month, net new MRR and net revenue retention, over a waterfall of the steps between them.
- [Billing: Current Plan](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/billing-02/README.md): The plan and its price, when it renews, the next invoice and the payment method on file, with actions to manage them.
- [Billing: Invoices](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/billing-03/README.md): Recent invoices with their status and amount, what's outstanding, and a PDF download for each.
- [Billing: Revenue Summary](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/billing-04/README.md): MRR, ARR, ARPU and net revenue retention, each with its change from the previous month written out.
- [Billing: Change Plan](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/billing-05/README.md): Plans side by side, monthly or yearly, with seats, what's due today and what a downgrade takes away.
- [CRM Table](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/crm-table/README.md): A sortable table of sales deals with stage pills, per-stage filter chips showing totals, and a live count and sum of the visible rows.
- [Inventory: Low Stock](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/inventory-01/README.md): Items at or near their reorder point, soonest to run out first, with how much to order and which will run out before an order arrives.
- [Inventory: Warehouse Capacity](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/inventory-02/README.md): Units stored against capacity in each warehouse, with what arrives this week and where a warehouse counts as nearly full.
- [Inventory: Stock Health](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/inventory-03/README.md): The value of stock on hand and how many times a year it turns over, then every SKU by status.
- [Inventory: Stock Projection](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/inventory-04/README.md): One item's stock day by day at its current demand, with incoming orders, the reorder point and the day it runs out.
- [Invoice: Invoice](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/invoice-01/README.md): An overdue invoice with a discount, sales tax, a deposit and the balance due, how to pay, and a reminder you can send.
- [Invoice: Receipt](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/invoice-02/README.md): A paid receipt with the payment method, a partial refund and the net amount paid.
- [Invoice: Quote](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/invoice-03/README.md): Optional items to tick before accepting, with totals that follow, an expiry date and a signature block on the printed copy.
- [Invoice: Packing Slip](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/invoice-04/README.md): Items with their SKU and bin, a checkbox for each one picked, and a scannable barcode of the order number.
- [Pipeline: Board](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/pipeline-01/README.md): A column per stage with its item count and total value, and a card per item with its owner, moved from its menu.
- [Pipeline: Stage Summary](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/pipeline-02/README.md): The open value, with each stage as a segment of one bar sized by value or by count.
- [Pipeline: Stuck Items](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/pipeline-03/README.md): Items over their expected time in stage, longest over first, with how long they've waited and who owns them.
- [Pipeline: Weighted Forecast](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/pipeline-04/README.md): Closed plus open deals weighted by the chance their stage closes, per owner, against quota.
- [Spend: Monthly Budget](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/spend-01/README.md): Spend so far against the month's budget, with the projected month end and what's left to spend per day.
- [Spend: Spend by Service](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/spend-02/README.md): The total spent and where it's heading, with a budget bar per service and the ones over or on pace to go over.
- [Spend: Spend vs Budget](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/spend-03/README.md): Monthly spend as bars against a stepped budget line, with months over budget labelled and the year-to-date variance.
- [Spend: Burn and Runway](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/spend-04/README.md): The cash balance, the average net burn and the months of runway left, with the balance projected to the month it runs out.
- [Usage Meter: Quota](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-01/README.md): An API quota with its status, when it resets, the usage it's on pace for and the date it would hit the limit.
- [Usage Meter: Storage Ring](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-02/README.md): Storage used as a ring in its status colour, with the space that's free.
- [Usage Meter: Metered Billing](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-03/README.md): The estimated overage, then usage against what the plan includes for each meter, with what each overage costs.
- [Usage Meter: Prepaid Credits](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-04/README.md): A credit balance with the days left, the date it runs out and recent daily use against the average.
- [Usage Meter: Storage Breakdown](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-05/README.md): Storage by category as one segmented bar, with each category's size and share, and the space that's free.
- [Usage Meter: Plan Limits](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-06/README.md): Every limit on a plan, flagging the ones nearly reached and prompting an upgrade.
- [Usage Meter: Liquid Gauge](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-07/README.md): What's left as a liquid that drains as usage grows, turning orange and then red.
- [Usage Meter: Liquid Ring](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/business/usage-meter-08/README.md): What's left as a round wave that drains as usage grows, with used, free and the days until reset below.

## Workspace

Settings, members, sign-in, security, files and activity.

- [Activity Feed: Recent Activity](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/activity-feed-01/README.md): What people did across a workspace, newest first and grouped by day.
- [Activity Feed: Record History](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/activity-feed-02/README.md): The history of one record as a timeline, oldest first, with each change from one value to the next and comments quoted in full.
- [Activity Feed: Notifications](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/activity-feed-03/README.md): Notifications with All, Mentions and Unread tabs, marked read one at a time or all at once.
- [Activity Feed: Weekly Digest](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/activity-feed-04/README.md): A week of activity as daily bars with the busiest day labelled, then the count of each kind of activity and the most active people.
- [Activity Feed: Social Activity](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/activity-feed-05/README.md): Slack and GitHub activity in one timeline, with quoted messages, actions such as starting a review, and what's waiting on you.
- [Auth: Accept Invite](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-01/README.md): The workspace, who invited you, the role you'll get and who's already there, with a prompt to switch account when the invite is for another address.
- [Auth: Workspace Picker](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-02/README.md): Every workspace you're in, with your role, pending invites you can join and a search once there are more than five.
- [Auth: Two-Factor Code](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-03/README.md): The 6-digit code from an authenticator app, with a recovery code instead, the tries left and an option to trust the device.
- [Auth: Verify Email](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-04/README.md): A code sent by email, a resend that waits a minute between emails, and a way to fix a mistyped address.
- [Auth: Sign In](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-05/README.md): One form to sign in or sign up, with Google, X and GitHub on one row and a row at the bottom that unfolds the sign-up fields.
- [Auth: Forgot Password](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-06/README.md): An email field that sends a reset link, then a check your email page with the mail apps to open and a resend that counts down.
- [Auth: Reset Password](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/auth-07/README.md): A new password with a strength meter and the rules it still needs, then a way back to sign in, or a new link when this one has expired.
- [Error Pages: Not Found](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/error-pages-01/README.md): The path that wasn't found, a search, and the places people usually look for.
- [Error Pages: No Access](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/error-pages-02/README.md): Who can give access, a request with an optional message, and the account you're signed in with.
- [Error Pages: Something Went Wrong](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/error-pages-03/README.md): Try again, an error ID to copy for support, and the technical details folded away.
- [Error Pages: Maintenance](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/error-pages-04/README.md): What's being done, when it'll be back, the latest updates and an email when it's over.
- [Error Pages: Session Ended](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/error-pages-05/README.md): Why the session ended, whether unsaved work was kept, and a sign-in link back to the same page.
- [Files: Upload](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/files-01/README.md): A dropzone with the accepted types and size limit, and each upload's progress, which you can cancel, retry or remove.
- [Files: File Table](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/files-02/README.md): Files with their type, owner, last change and size, to search, filter, sort, download or delete.
- [Files: Storage](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/files-03/README.md): Storage used against the plan, split by kind of file, with the largest files and how much deleting them would free.
- [Files: Folder Browser](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/files-04/README.md): Folders as tiles over a list of files with their size and last change, and a path back to the top.
- [Note Outline](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/note-outline/README.md): A note document view with a notebook tree, breadcrumb and content blocks, plus an outline built from the headings that scrolls each one into view.
- [Notifications: Bell](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/notifications-01/README.md): The latest notifications in a panel, with mark all as read and a link to the inbox.
- [Notifications: Requests](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/notifications-02/README.md): Notifications that ask for a decision, such as a request to join or a refund, with a tab of the ones still waiting.
- [Notifications: Inbox](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/notifications-03/README.md): Every notification grouped by day, filtered by unread and mentions, to mark read or unread or archive.
- [Onboarding: Setup Wizard](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/onboarding-01/README.md): Name the workspace and pick its URL, say what it's for, then invite the team.
- [Onboarding: Welcome](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/onboarding-02/README.md): The first page of an empty workspace: quick starts, an empty dashboards list with a way in, setup progress and help.
- [Onboarding: Connect a Source](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/onboarding-03/README.md): Search and pick a source, then follow it through connecting to connected.
- [Onboarding: Personalise](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/onboarding-04/README.md): A role, a team size and up to three goals, turned into the dashboards set up for them.
- [Record Detail: Customer](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/record-detail-01/README.md): Headline numbers, recent orders, contact details and notes.
- [Record Detail: Order](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/record-detail-02/README.md): Line items with totals, a timeline of what happened, the customer, and shipping and payment.
- [Record Detail: Ticket](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/record-detail-03/README.md): A description, activity with comments, a comment box, and properties such as priority, assignee and labels.
- [Security: Sign-in Activity](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/security-01/README.md): Failed and blocked sign-ins per day against a typical day, with the failure rate, any spike in blocked attempts and MFA coverage.
- [Security: Audit Log](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/security-02/README.md): Changes to access, keys and settings, newest first, with a toggle to show only warnings and critical changes.
- [Security: Active Sessions](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/security-03/README.md): The devices signed in to an account, with where and when each was last active, and buttons to sign them out.
- [Security: Security Posture](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/security-04/README.md): A weighted score on a gauge, with failing checks first and what to do about each.
- [Security: Two-Factor Authentication](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/security-05/README.md): An authenticator app, security keys, passkeys and recovery codes, with the last method kept while the workspace requires two-factor.
- [Security: Single Sign-On](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/security-06/README.md): A SAML connection with the details for your identity provider, domains verified by TXT record, and a switch to require SSO.
- [Settings: Members](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-01/README.md): Members and pending invites with their roles, and seats counted against the plan.
- [Settings: API Keys](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-02/README.md): Keys with their access, when they were last used and who created them, with a new key shown once.
- [Settings: Notifications](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-03/README.md): Each notification against each channel, grouped by topic, with a switch per channel.
- [Settings: Integrations](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-04/README.md): Connected and available integrations, with what they do and the ones that need reconnecting.
- [Settings: Webhooks](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-05/README.md): Endpoints with the events they receive, their recent deliveries, the delivery rate and a switch to pause each one.
- [Settings: Danger Zone](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-06/README.md): Transferring, archiving and deleting the workspace.
- [Settings: Profile](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/settings-07/README.md): Your photo, name, email, time zone and theme, in the same sections and save bar as the [Forms](/docs/blocks/forms) blocks.
- [Sign In: Split](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/sign-in-split/README.md): A split sign-in screen: the workspace sign-in form on the left, and a panel with a slowly flowing gradient background and an optional quote on the right.
- [Sign Up: Split](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/sign-up-split/README.md): A two-column sign-up form with neutral provider buttons, a password strength meter measured from the password, a terms checkbox and a highlights and testimonial panel.
- [Team: Member List](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/team-01/README.md): Members with their role, presence and when they were last active.
- [Team: Workload](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/team-02/README.md): The points assigned against the team's capacity, then each person on a shared scale, with anyone over capacity first.
- [Team: Who's Online](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/team-03/README.md): How many people are online, with their avatars, and the team split by presence.
- [Team: On Call](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/team-04/README.md): Who is on call now and until when, who is next, and the rest of the rota.
- [Team: Roles and Permissions](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/team-05/README.md): A grid of permissions by role, with changes highlighted until they're saved or discarded.
- [Team: Share](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/workspace/team-06/README.md): People invited to a dashboard with view or edit access, and who the link works for.

## Operations

Service status, deployments and alerts.

- [Alerts: Inbox](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/alerts-01/README.md): Alerts, most recent first, each with a button to acknowledge it and a count of what still needs a response.
- [Alerts: Threshold Breach](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/alerts-02/README.md): The metric over the last hour against its threshold, with the line turning red above it and how far over it is now.
- [Alerts: Rules](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/alerts-03/README.md): Alert rules with their conditions, severities and channels, which one fired last, and a switch to pause each one.
- [Alerts: Summary](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/alerts-04/README.md): A slim strip with open alerts by severity and the latest one, for the top of a dashboard.
- [Deployments: Recent Deployments](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/deployments-01/README.md): The latest builds with their commit, environment, author, duration and status.
- [Deployments: Environments](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/deployments-02/README.md): What each environment is running and how many commits are waiting to be promoted to the next.
- [Deployments: Delivery Performance](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/deployments-03/README.md): The four DORA metrics with the change on the period before and the band each one falls in.
- [Deployments: Build Health](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/deployments-04/README.md): The last runs of each pipeline as a strip, with the pass rate, median duration and the pipeline that fails most.
- [Server Card](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/server-card/README.md): A grid of host cards, each with its name, region, provider, status, specs and CPU, memory and disk meters that turn amber and red as they fill.
- [Status: Service List](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/status-01/README.md): Each service with its current status, the worst one above the title and every service that isn't operational named.
- [Status: Uptime Bars](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/status-02/README.md): Ninety days of daily status per service.
- [Status: Incident](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/status-03/README.md): An active incident with its severity, the services it affects and its updates, newest first.
- [Status: Region Health](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/status-04/README.md): Regions with their status, p95 latency and error rate.
- [Status: Service Uptime](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/status-05/README.md): One service's uptime, incident count and downtime, with its daily history and recent incidents.
- [Workflow Builder](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/operations/workflow-builder/README.md): A vertical flow canvas of trigger, action and condition steps joined by lines, with an add-step button between nodes and a settings form for the selected step.

- [Email: Payment Failed](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/email/email-04/README.md): The amount due on the panel with the card and the bank's reason, Update card, and when the card is tried again before the plan stops.
- [Email: Trial Ending](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/email/email-05/README.md): The days left on the panel with Add a card, and what changes on the plan the workspace moves to without one.

## Pages

Complete ready-made pages such as status and product screens.

- [Engineering Status](https://github.com/aliakseych/components/blob/main/components/pages/engineering-status/README.md): A public status page: regions banner, 90-day uptime strips per service, active incidents with update timelines, and a fortnight of incident history.
